tool.name: 3Dtrees: RayCloudTools
tool.command: ln -s '$input' 'input.${input.ext}' && python3 -u /src/run.py --dataset-path 'input.${input.ext}' --output-dir 'out' --gradient '$gradient' --max-diameter '$max_diameter' --crop-length '$crop_length' --distance-limit '$distance_limit' --height-min '$height_min' --girth-height-ratio '$girth_height_ratio' --global-taper '$global_taper' --global-taper-factor '$global_taper_factor' --gravity-factor '$gravity_factor' $branch_segmentation $treeinfo $branch_data && ## Mesh artifacts can be absent depending on the run mv "out/input_segmented.laz" '$segmented_laz' && if [ -f "out/input_trees_mesh.ply" ]; then mv "out/input_trees_mesh.ply" '$tree_mesh_ply'; fi && if [ -f "out/input_mesh.ply" ]; then mv "out/input_mesh.ply" '$terrain_mesh_ply'; fi && #if $treeinfo mv "out/input_trees_info.txt" '$tree_info_txt' #else mv "out/input_trees.txt" '$tree_model_txt' #end if

param.label: Maximum diameter
param.help: maximum trunk diameter in segmenting trees (m)

param.label: Crop length
param.help: Reconstruct the QSM up to this distance from branch tips (m).

param.label: Distance limit
param.help: Maximum distance between neighbour points in a tree (m)

param.label: Minimum tree height
param.help: Minimum height counted as a tree (m)

param.label: Girth height ratio
param.help: Amount up tree's height to estimate trunk girth

param.label: Global taper
param.help: Force taper value (diameter per length) for trees under global_taper_factor of max tree height - use 0 to estimate global taper from the data

param.label: Global taper factor
param.help: 1 estimates same taper for whole scan, 0 is per-tree tapering, values between 0 and 1 produce soft cutoff at this amount of max tree height

param.label: Branch segmentation
param.help: Add segment IDs in PredBranch_RCT while retaining tree IDs in PredInstance_RCT. Zero means unassigned.

param.label: Treeinfo
param.help: Calculate tree attributes - dbh, height, crown radius, volume, ...

param.label: Branch data
param.help: Calculate additional branch attributes (branch number, segment length, order, extension and position). Only used when Treeinfo is enabled; otherwise ignored.

tool.help:
**What it does**
This tool performs graph-based tree instance segmentation on LiDAR point clouds using the **RayExtract** algorithm (Devereux et al., 2026) implemented as part of **RayCloudTools** (Lowe & Stepanas, 2021). It is platform-agnostic and works across airborne (ULS), terrestrial (TLS), and mobile (MLS) laser scanning data, as long as trees are well-represented by points along the entire tree length.
-----
**Processing Steps**
- Prepare a temporary LAZ 1.2 copy for native processing - Import point cloud as ray cloud - Extract terrain - Extract trees - Convert point color (segmentation result) to instance IDs - Add instance IDs to a new copy of the original point cloud, preserving its LAS version, point format, dimensions and metadata - Optional: Calculate tree attributes (dbh, height, crown radius, volume, ...)
-----
**Input and metadata**
LAZ inputs may omit GPS time. The segmented output preserves the original point order and dimension values, XYZ scales and offsets, CRS, ExtraBytes descriptors, and non-structural VLRs/EVLRs. The temporary LAZ 1.2 processing copy does not change the original input or the segmented output's LAS version.
COPC indexing records are removed because the output is sequential LAZ. Waveform point formats (4, 5, 9 and 10) are rejected because waveform payload preservation is not supported. Metadata or label validation failures fail the job.
-----
**Outputs**
- **Segmented point cloud (LAZ):** tree IDs in `PredInstance_RCT`. With branch segmentation enabled, also includes `PredBranch_RCT` (native `section_id + 1`). Zero means unassigned. Segment IDs include root/trunk sections and are distinct from the branch-order attributes calculated by Treeinfo with Branch data. - **Tree model (TXT):** cylinder models, produced when `treeinfo` is disabled - **Tree info (TXT):** produced when `treeinfo` is enabled - **Tree meshes (PLY):** one combined mesh with an unsigned `tree_id` on every triangle face, matching native tree-file rows (1-based). These IDs match `PredInstance_RCT` in both modes; they do not identify `PredBranch_RCT` segments. - **Terrain meshes (PLY)**
Tree ownership is embedded in the tree PLY; no separate CSV is needed. Downstream merge/filter operations must preserve and remap these IDs together with the LAZ and tree files. This tool does not generate a viewer GLB.
This wrapper processes one input file per job. If you pass a collection in Galaxy workflows, Galaxy will iterate the tool over the collection and can parallelize those jobs.
***Tip:** We recommend using the '3DTrees: Tile and Merge' or '3DTrees: Smart Tile' tool to process large point clouds (workflow: tile → segment → merge)!*
